title: The Adventure Begins
logline: When eager young Keen sails away from home and into a sudden storm, saving a trapped dolphin teaches him that real courage begins with the gulp before the leap — and earns him his place among the Crystal Bears.

episodeVision.premise: Keen leaves the safety of his Mum and Crystal Cove with empty heirloom wristbands, gets lost in a storm, saves Squeaky before he feels ready, and is welcomed into the Crystal Bears when his earned courage becomes visible.
episodeVision.dramaticQuestion: Can Keen discover that courage is not looking fearless, but acting through the fear when someone else needs him?
episodeVision.theme: You can be scared and brave at the same time; belonging travels with you, and sometimes it is waiting for you on the far shore.
episodeVision.externalJourney: A warm morning goodbye becomes a solo sailing trip, a storm, a lost boat, an underwater rescue, a beach landing, and finally a post-storm ceremony where Keen receives the Aquamarine gems in his wristbands.
episodeVision.internalJourney: Keen starts performing readiness for his Mum, loses his map and certainty, steadies himself through the fear, acts selflessly for Squeaky, and ends no longer pretending to be brave because the group has witnessed the real thing.
episodeVision.relationshipChanges: Keen and his Mum move from held safety to trusted separation; Keen and Squeaky become rescue-bonded friends; Aida moves from distant knower to welcoming elder; the Crystal Bears shift from strangers on the shore to Keen's new family; Fuzzby and Zenny turn from comic witnesses into the alarm that connects the worlds.
episodeVision.emotionalCurve: Playful morning comedy opens into a held parental goodbye, tips into storm fear and underwater strain, releases through rescue laughter, settles into grateful welcome, and closes warmer than it began with the memory of Mum still behind him.
episodeVision.comedyCurve: Fuzzby's body-first bee chaos starts the episode, returns as emergency slapstick under pressure, then transforms into worshipful awe of Keen and finally the honey-friendship button; Keen inherits the same cover-up comedy in his boat wobble.
episodeVision.setupPayoffMap: Fuzzby's 'Nailed it' bravado sets up Keen's 'Still got it' cover; the empty wristbands from Mum pay off as faint self-glow underwater and then as Aquamarine-set gems; Aida's vision of the pier pays off in her arrival and welcome; Squeaky's playful chirps pay off as urgent calls and then the rescue ride; Mum's 'never alone' lands again through Aida and the group hug.
episodeVision.visualMotifs: Gold pollen and bee-scale flowers; empty gold wristbands; warm hands letting go; a tiny boat against huge water; aqua light in cold blue storm water; a crystal beacon cutting rain; washed-clean droplets; a circle becoming a hug; golden-hour beach path.
episodeVision.sonicMotifs: Fuzzby's manic buzzing and crash impacts; Zenny's dry stillness; Aida's bowl tone dissolving into wind; Squeaky's chirps shifting from play to distress to relief; Keen's breath/gulp motif; Aquamarine B-note emerging from faint wristband hum; the bears' combined crystal chord as rescue beacon.
episodeVision.climax: Underwater, with Squeaky trapped and a massive wave building above, Keen plants himself against the rock, the vacant wristbands glow from within, and he tears the net free before being thrown through the storm water and carried back by Squeaky.
episodeVision.resolution: Aida awards the Aquamarine, the gems settle into Keen's father’s wristbands, the group swamps him in a hug, and he accepts that he has found family without losing the one he sailed away from.
episodeVision.intendedFinalFeeling: Bright, relieved belonging with a bittersweet trace: Keen is laughing with new friends in golden light, but the journey still carries the cost of Mum opening her hands at the pier.

orderedEvents.text: Tall flowers sway gently in the warm breeze. Some stretch high above the grass, with long soft necks and bright open petals full of pollen. FUZZBY and ZENNY weave between them collecting pollen from flower to flower. Fine golden pollen dusts their paws and trails softly through the air. Zenny works with smooth calm precision — neat, efficient, graceful. Fuzzby does not. He zig-zags wildly through the air, humming loudly to himself as he works.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…
He dips low into a flower, scoops up pollen — then overdoes it and spins sideways into a leaf. FWIP. He bounces back into the air and straightens up proudly.

orderedEvents.speaker: Fuzzby
orderedEvents.text: Nailed it.
Zenny glides up beside him. Watches him for a beat.

beats.storyBeat: At bee height in the wildflower field, Zenny's graceful work and Fuzzby's chaotic self-importance define the comedy world before his first overcommitted pollen scoop rebounds off a leaf and he claims mastery anyway.
beats.want: Fuzzby wants to look like a brilliant, efficient pollen professional.
beats.need: He needs to be loved even when his body proves he is messy and ridiculous.
beats.kidRead: Funny bee zooms, bonks, bounces, and says he meant it.
beats.adultRead: A tiny performer is trying to earn status by covering embarrassment instantly.
beats.emotionalIntent: Buoyant opening laugh; establish character contrast and the bravado mask before any danger appears.

orderedEvents.text: Gentle waves roll onto the shore. AIDA sits in stillness beside a crystal bowl. She runs the wand softly around the rim. A low shimmering tone fills the air.
